# Core parts
A full set of AniScope parts takes approximately 25 hours to print, depending on your printer speed settings. These are the parts you need for a minimal setup - also see the parts rendered below.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Default

::: {layout="[80,20]" layout-valign="center"}

| Part | Quantity | Print Time | STL |
|------|----------|------------|-----|
| Bottom piece | 1 | ~8 hrs | <a href="../examples/default/aniscope-floor-hex.stl" download>Download STL</a> |
| Top piece (with mount) | 1 | ~5 hrs | |
| Platform adapter | 2 | ~5 (10) hrs | |
| Camera mount | 1 | ~2 hrs | |

: {tbl-colwidths="[40,20,20,20]"}

![](../../assets/finished-setup.jpeg)

:::

## Compact

| Part | Quantity | Print Time | STL |
|------|----------|------------|-----|
| Bottom piece | 1 | ~4 hrs | |
| Top piece | 1 | ~3 hrs | |
